name: The Reaction - Amy
source:
The protagonist invites his girlfriend (Amy) to dinner for the holiday. 
Christmas is about caring. How much attention do you pay to Amy?

[From [url=https://sxrobertvn.itch.io/the-reaction-amy-v10-sxrobert-vn]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
主角邀請女友艾米共進晚餐，一起過節。
聖誕節的意義在於關懷。你究竟有多在意艾米呢？
